output.one_liner: Shopify provides a comprehensive suite of REST and GraphQL APIs for ecommerce merchants, enabling app developers to manage products, orders, customers, and more.
output.access_note: Developers can create and manage apps, set up dev stores, and obtain API credentials directly in the Dev Dashboard without a paid plan.
output.blocker: Requires OAuth app installation and merchant approval for access scopes.

evidence.quote: GraphQL Admin API | Your app, on behalf of a merchant | OAuth, usually token exchange
The Dev Dashboard is where you create and manage apps, set up dev stores, and see how your app performs for merchants.
GraphQL Admin API reads and writes products, customers, orders, inventory, and the rest of the data behind the Shopify admin.
Shopify MCP lets merchants and partners set up and manage a store through the AI agent of their choice.
